items.title: 1.1.1.1 Doosre tareeqe: Scrum aur Lean (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Scrum and Lean with Figs. 1.4 and 1.5 (PDF 13-15).

blocks.text: Scrum ek Agile framework hai jo pecheeda software projects chalane aur mukammal karne ke liye aam istemal hota hai. Yeh dohrao wali (iterative) taraqqi, mil jul kar kaam aur lachak ko barhata hai, is liye un badalte mahaulon ke liye munasib hai jahan requirements aksar badalti hain. Yeh roles, events aur artifacts par mabni hai jo munazzam magar dhalne wala tareeqa dete hain (Fig. 1.4).

items: Roles: Product Owner product backlog tay karta aur team ko sab se zyada tarjeeh wale kaamon par rakhta hai; Scrum Master amal ko aasan banata, rukawatein hatata aur yaqeeni banata hai ke team Scrum par chale; mukhtalif maharaton wali Development Team product ke hisse (increments) deti hai.
Events: sprints (waqt ki had wale iterations), sprint planning, rozana stand-ups, sprint reviews aur sprint retrospectives.
Artifacts: product backlog (features aur requirements ki tarjeehi list), sprint backlog (ek sprint ke kaam) aur increment (sprint ke aakhir mein kaam karta product).

blocks.text: Scrum un projects ke liye munasib hai jin mein baar baar updates aur badalti requirements hon, jaise mobile applications aur web development, jahan users ki raaye aur market ki tabdeeli par jaldi tabdeeliyan hoti hain. Yeh un projects ke liye munasib nahi ho sakta jin ki requirements wazeh aur kam badalne wali hon, jaise hardware se jure aur sakht qawaneen wale embedded systems, ya medical ya aerospace jaise hifazat ke lihaz se nazuk (safety-critical) software jinhein tafseeli dastavezat aur wasee tasdeeq chahiye.

Lean software development dohrao wala tareeqa hai jo kaarkardagi, zaya (waste) khatam karne aur aala maiyar ke products jaldi dene par zor deta hai. Lean manufacturing ke usoolon se nikla yeh tareeqa kaam ke bahao ko behtar kar ke aur ghair zaroori sargarmiyan kam kar ke customer ko qadr (value) deta hai (Fig. 1.5).

items: Zaya khatam karein: woh sargarmiyan hatayein jo customer ke liye qadr nahi barhatin.
Seekhna barhayein: musalsal behtari aur seekhne ka mahaul banayein.
Jitna der se ho sake faisla karein: taaza tareen maloomat se faisla kar ke ghair yaqeeni kam karein.
Jitna jaldi ho sake dein: features ke chhote hisse jaldi dein.
Team ko ikhtiyar dein: teams ko faisle aur masail hal karne ka ikhtiyar aur zimmedari dein.
Maiyar andar rakhein: development bhar maiyar qaim rakhein.
Poora dekhein: kaam ka bahao behtar karne ke liye poore nizam aur us ke mahaul par ghaur karein.

blocks.text: Lean un projects ke liye munasib hai jinhein tez delivery aur baar baar iterations chahiyein, jaise startup software, mobile applications aur web services: nayi mobile app banane wala startup users ki raaye par jaldi dohrao se faida uthata hai. Yeh un projects ke liye munasib nahi ho sakta jinhein pehle se wasee mansooba bandi chahiye aur jo bohat pecheeda ya qawaneen ke paband hon, jaise bare enterprise systems, embedded systems ya aviation control jaise hifazati nazuk applications, jinhein sakht dastavezat, testing aur qawaneen ki paasdari chahiye.

blocks.alt: Oopar: product backlog se sprint planning, sprint backlog aur rozana scrum wale sprint se increment aur sprint review tak Scrum lifecycle, retrospective wapas planning ko. Neeche baen: Lean ke saat usool numbered list mein. Neeche daen: Dev aur Ops ke do jure chakkar, plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate aur monitor ke saath.
blocks.caption: Scrum, Lean aur DevOps (Figures 1.4 se 1.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Scrum mein product owner tarjeehi product backlog rakhta hai; sprint planning par team items sprint backlog mein leti, chand hafton ke sprint mein rozana mukhtasar scrum ke saath un par kaam karti, aur kaam karta increment banati hai jo sprint review par dikhaya jata hai; phir retrospective agla sprint behtar karta hai. Lean ke saat usool hain: zaya khatam karna, seekhna barhana, jitna der se ho sake faisla, jitna jaldi ho sake dena, team ko ikhtiyar, maiyar andar rakhna aur poora dekhna. DevOps development aur operations ko planning, coding, building, testing, releasing, deploying, operating aur monitoring ke ek musalsal chakkar mein jorta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa role rukawatein hatata aur Scrum ke tareeqe aasan banata hai (MCQ 5)? Scrum ke aham hisse bataiye aur har ek project management mein kaise madad deta hai (short question 4).
blocks.explanation: Scrum Master, option (b). Roles wazeh zimmedari dete hain (Product Owner tarjeeh tay karta, Scrum Master amal chalata, team banati hai); events planning, rozana ham-aahangi, review aur behtari ka baqaida silsila dete hain; artifacts kaam ko nazar aane wala banate hain (kya chahiye, is sprint mein kya hai, kya diya gaya).

blocks.prompt: Ek project ko wasee dastavezat chahiyein aur sakht qawaneen ki pabandi hai. Scrum is ke liye kyun munasib nahi, aur is ki jagah kya istemal ho sakta hai (long question 3)?
blocks.explanation: Scrum requirements ko sprint ba sprint badalta aur dastavezat halki rakhta hai, jabke qawaneen ke paband projects ko mustaqil, poori tarah darj requirements aur har marhale par rasmi manzoori chahiye; Waterfall jaisa mansooba-band model, har marhale se pehle mukammal dastavezat aur manzoori ke saath, behtar hai.

items: Scrum: Agile framework jis mein roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Development Team), events (sprints, planning, stand-ups, review, retrospective) aur artifacts (product backlog, sprint backlog, increment) hain; mobile aur web apps ke liye munasib, embedded ya hifazati nazuk nizamon ke liye nahi.
Lean: Lean manufacturing se; zaya khatam karne se poora dekhne tak saat usool; startups aur tez dohrao wali apps ke liye munasib, sakht qawaneen wale nizamon ke liye nahi.
